description: Oakland Bike Wayfinding Sign Projects is a dataset listed in City of Oakland open data portal (data.oaklandca.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Oakland. To download a projected shapefile of this dataset, please click "Download Projected Shapefile: Oakland Bike Wayfinding Sign Projects" under "Attachments" below. This data includes the status of projects to implement Oakland's bicycle wayfinding sign system; Projects are constructed by corridor. Coverage: Oakland. The portal files it under the category Infrastructure. Its tags are signs, bike, bikeway, network, wayfinding. The table has 9 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Oakland, Bicycle & Pedestrian Program. The portal shows 2026-08-04 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-oaklandca-gov-portal.
